Suddenly, your bodies seemed to grow lighter.{w}
You stepped into a certain room in the Palace of the Sun.{w}Necrophilis was there, looking rather disgruntled.{w}
"Why do I, of all people, have to play guard dog!?{w}That braid-head really pisses me off!"{w}

"Still, this Palace of the Sun...{w}there's some seriously nasty energy
pouring in here, more and more of it."{w}{p}"...Hey, Narv!!"{w}
"Just what are you trying to make me do!?{w}It's about time you told me what Mayer's up to!"{w}
"Keep this up and I'll turn you into a corpse too, got it!?"{w}

"......I bear the form of Narv, yet I am not
the Narv of the Real Axis.{w}We are the Spirit of the Dark Realm: Numbra Narv."{w}
"The enemy is here, Necrophilis. Intercept them.{w}Do not let them near the Zenith Arc."{w}{p}"Should you fail,{w}it is you who will become the corpse."{w}
"Every damn one of you, treating me like a joke!!"{w}
"Screw that!{w}Like I'd take orders from you bastards...{w}Take orders... from... dammit...!"{w}{p}"I just have to kill them, right?{w}Kill these guys and you'll be satisfied, right...{w}

Face twisted with rage and sorrow,
Necrophilis came at you!{w}
"Gaaah!{w}...I never thought you'd gotten this strong..."{w}

Propping up a body covered in wounds,
Necrophilis staggered, trying to stand.{w}

"Narv...{w}You idiot... Coming to back me up now?
You're way too damn late..."{w}

Necrophilis was struck by a fierce bolt of lightning.{w}{p}Once-white skin was charred black, clothes and all,
and dark smoke rose from Necrophilis's throat.{w}Then, slowly, Necrophilis crumpled to the ground.{w}

"It still breathes, barely.{w}It failed this time, but we shall have it
do one more job elsewhere."{w}

A dark abyss welled up around Narv and the others.{w}Without so much as a twitch, the demon girl
was swallowed into the bottomless abyss...{w}

"We, too, are short on time.{w}If you mean to stand in our way, come prepared
to meet the same fate."{w}

Leaving those ominous words behind,
Narv and the others departed.{w}
"Gaaah!{w}...I never thought you'd gotten this strong..."{w}

Propping up a body covered in wounds,
Necrophilis staggered, trying to stand.{w}
"You too shall join the ranks of the dead."{w}

"...Maybe that wouldn't be so bad.
In the end, I could never belong to this world anyway..."{w}

As if to shield Necrophilis's wounded body from view,
the corpses rose up as one horde.{w}

"Dead things... What do you think you are doing,
you will-less husks?"{w}

"...Emera, maybe that hocus-pocus of yours
worked after all."{w}{p}"...If you guys are going to protect me..."{w}
"Corpses will not serve even as a shield."{w}

The writhing horde of the dead was swept away by a fierce bolt of lightning.{w}But where the dead had stood as a wall,
Necrophilis was nowhere to be seen.{w}

A dark abyss welled up around Narv and the others.{w}The silenced corpses, now one black mass,
were swallowed into the bottomless abyss...{w}

"We, too, are short on time.{w}If you mean to stand in our way, come prepared:
we will show no mercy."{w}

Leaving those ominous words behind,
Narv and the others departed.{w}

The wounded Sun God appeared before you.{w}

"It's nice to meet you, everyone...{w}I'm sorry... to appear like this.{w}I am... the Sun Spirit... Rafa."{w}{p}"The people of the land...{w}call me the Sun God, but..."{w}{p}"I'm nothing... so grand... as a god...{w}Just a spirit... who happened to be suited for it."{w}{p}"Thank you...{w}for taking back the Palace of the Sun."{w}{p}"Now, once again...
I can give everyone... light...{w}Ngh... uugh..."{w}

With that, the Sun Spirit Rafa lost consciousness.{w}{p}There was still something left for you to do.{w}{p}Was there no way to save the wounded
Sun Spirit Rafa...?{w}

"Thank you...{w}for taking back the Palace of the Sun."{w}{p}"Now, once again...
I can give everyone... light...{w}Ngh... uugh..."{w}

With that, the Sun Spirit Rafa lost consciousness.{w}{p}There was still something left for you to do.{w}{p}Was there no way to save the wounded
Sun Spirit Rafa...?{w}

You held up the Light Rank you had obtained
in the Sanctum of Genesis.{w}
"Yorfa!"{w}{p}"Yorfa...{w}I made you worry so much too, didn't I?"{w}

"Thank goodness...{w}Rafa... I'm so, so glad..."{w}{p}"I was so worried about you, Rafa,
I wanted to save you, and that's why I..."{w}
"It's all right now, Yorfa.{w}Everything has been resolved.{w}All thanks to these adventurers."{w}
"Mm... Thank you, adventurers.{w}Thank you for saving Rafa..."{w}{p}"I..."{w}
"A storybook happy ending if ever I saw one.{w}Well, it's all thanks to me, naturally.{w}You'd better be grateful, you lot."{w}

Before you knew it, a battered, ragged Zaalhaut
was standing behind you.{w}
"Hm? What's with that baffled look?{w}As if I'd kick the bucket over a little thing like that."{w}

The light of the Palace of the Sun was more beautiful than ever.{w}It seemed to foretell the future of this land,
and of all the people who live upon it.{w}

"The presence of darkness grows thicker still..."{w}{p}"Mayer, can you truly free and save Rafa?"{w}
"Of course. Once all is done, I will take you all to whatever land you desire, as promised."{w}

"......"{w}{p}"Rafa, wait for me...
I won't let you suffer any longer."{w}

"My, how desperate.
It's enough to make me cry... Ahahaha!"{w}
"That Moonlight Spirit seems to have room in her head for nothing but her own goals."{w}

"All the better for us...
Let her dance to our tune while she can."{w}
"Well, I never thought it would come to this!"{w}{p}"It's all because of that swindler, that Zaalhaut or whatever...{w}That wretch...!!"{w}
"She did a great deal for us."{w}
"But your body, Rafa, it keeps getting more and more...!"{w}
"You're so kind, Rafa, that everyone takes advantage and deceives you."{w}{p}"They use you however they please...{w}Poor, poor Rafa."{w}
"It's all right. I'll save you, okay?{w}I'll set you free from all that pain, okay?"{w}
"Shaharon and the others are going to separate you from the True Crystal, Rafa."{w}{p}"Until then, I won't let anyone into this Chamber of the True Sun."{w}
"Yorfa! That's enough!{w}I'm doing this of my own free will!"{w}
"It's all right, Rafa.{w}I'll protect you.{w}I'll save you, I swear."{w}
"...So now... even my words can't reach you...{w}Yorfa..."{w}
"Don't touch me!{w}You're out of your mind right now!"{w}
"Why?{w}Why would you say something like that?"{w}
"Yorfa! Please, go back to who you used to be!"{w}{p}"We watched over the land together in Nertowa, didn't we!"{w}{p}"Be the way you were back then! I'm begging you!!"{w}

"It's all right, we can go back."{w}{p}"Once I set you free, you and I will be just like before.
Like old times... together forever..."{w}{p}"Nothing else matters..."{w}
"Listen, Rafa..."{w}{p}"I won't let you suffer any longer."{w}{p}"If it means losing you..."{w}
"...then let the land be swallowed by darkness."{w}
"Why...{w}Why do you keep getting in my way?"{w}
In the Chamber of the True Sun, at the very heart of the Palace of the Sun, was the Moonlight Spirit, Yorfa.{w}
"Beyond here... is where Rafa is, you know.{w}Yes, my very own Rafa.{w}Mine, and mine alone..."{w}
Yorfa went on, wearing a look of rapture.{w}
"Would you all please step back?{w}I'm begging you, don't get in my way."{w}{p}"I'll ask you once more.{w}Would you please step back, adventurers?"{w}
"...I see. Then it can't be helped."{w}
Little by little, Yorfa began to change.{w}
"Why?{w}Why won't you just leave me be?"{w}
Tears poured endlessly from Yorfa's eyes.{w}
"I just... I just...{w}I just want to save Rafa...{w}That's all, and yet..."{w}
"I just want to save Rafa...{w}That's all, and yet..."{w}

You stepped into a certain room in the Palace of the Sun.{w}{p}Shaharon was there, wearing a cruel smile.{w}

"......Shaharon. You too were once a spirit,
the same as Yorfa and that lot."{w}

"...Then fulfill your duty
as a trusted right hand."{w}{p}"Shaharon, do not let them near
the Zenith Arc."{w}{p}"Should you fail,
it is your own death
you will be touching."{w}

"Very well."{w}{p}"Now, adventurers.
Let me hear you lament your ruin."{w}

With a heartless laugh,
Shaharon came at you!{w}

"Ngh!
...To think you would drive me this far..."{w}

Letting out a dreadful groan,
Shaharon staggered toward you.{w}
Shaharon was struck by a fierce bolt of lightning.{w}{p}Dark smoke rose from Shaharon's body in countless trails, and those two long arms crumpled to the floor, robes and all.{w}

"Let us go and dispose
of the useless one."{w}
A dark abyss welled up around Narv and the others.{w}The spirit who had drowned in the power of darkness was swallowed into the bottomless abyss along with Narv, leaving no trace...{w}

"Defy us, and you will suffer the same.
Take that to heart."{w}

Leaving those ominous words behind,
Narv departed.{w}

With a strange whirring, a Tetramystica glides across the floor.{w}{p}A Tetramystica specialized for guard duty -- a "Guard Mystica," you might call it.{w}{p}Here and there the students have scrawled on it: "Idiot," "Moron," even doodled nose hairs.{w}Even so, its function of guarding the Academy is still fully intact.{w}{p}So it is only natural that, on spotting you outsiders who don't belong to the Academy, it moves to eliminate you.{w}

You have run into a foe you never expected.{w}A vast form, its whole body blazing with light.{w}{p}Without a sound, the very air shudders and trembles.{w}With the word "alien" lodged in your hearts, you stand exposed to its savage power.{w}
Suddenly, a gigantic beast appears before you.{w}Half tiger and half horse, it flails its arms and thrashes its whole body wildly.{w}{p}And now its fury turns on you as well.{w}

Darkness within darkness.{w}Welling up from the abode of the Nether King, it fills the air around it with an incomprehensible tongue.{w}{p}What it is saying: unknown.{w}What it is even trying to do: unknown.{w}{p}But one thing is clear:
it means to destroy you.{w}

A giant leaps out in front of you.{w}It seems to be distracted by something else.{w}{p}It doesn't appear able to tell whether you are enemies or mere visitors.{w}{p}No -- for just a moment it seemed to give it some thought, but
'Eh, I'll just punch them for now and...'{w}seems to be the conclusion it reached.{w}
You succeeded in driving off the fearsome enemy.
You fled from the Floor Master.
